text.autoconfig.autotools.title: AutoTools Config
AutoTools will always be active and try to get you the best tool. Can be toggled with the set key.
AutoTools will always be active and try to get you the best tool. Can be toggled with the set key.
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.disable: Disables AutoTools in creative-mode if toggle is disabled
Disables AutoTools in creative-mode if toggle is disabled
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.keepSlo: Keeps the selected slot when swapping to a new tool instead of using the vanilla mechanics
Keeps the selected slot when swapping to a new tool instead of using the vanilla mechanics
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.preferH: AutoTools will prefer the tool already in your hotbar if multiple tools have the same mining speed, regardless their durability
AutoTools will prefer the tool already in your hotbar if multiple tools have the same mining speed, regardless their durability
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.preferL: AutoTools will prefer the tool with the lower durability, instead of the higher one, if they have the same mining speed
AutoTools will prefer the tool with the lower durability, instead of the higher one, if they have the same mining speed
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.alwaysP: Autotools will use Fortune for Gravel and Leaves
Autotools will use Fortune for Gravel and Leaves
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.onlySwi: AutoTools will only switch items if you can't mine a block with your current one
AutoTools will only switch items if you can't mine a block with your current one
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.switchB: AutoTools will switch back to the previous tool or item you had in your hand before breaking the block
AutoTools will switch back to the previous tool or item you had in your hand before breaking the block
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.showDPS: Displays the weapons Dps when hovering over it
Displays the weapons Dps when hovering over it
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.changeF: AutoTools will change to the tool with the most DPS when looking at an entity
AutoTools will change to the tool with the most DPS when looking at an entity
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.keepAxe: AutoTools won't change to a better weapon(e.g. a sword) when holding an axe
AutoTools won't change to a better weapon(e.g. a sword) when holding an axe

text.autoconfig.autotools.option.minDura:
If < 1: Seen as a percentage: Tools below minDurability won't be selected
Else: Seen as durability: tools will be selected until at minDurability (e.g. set to 1 to never break a tool)

If < 1: Seen as a percentage: Tools below minDurability won't be selected
Else: Seen as durability: tools will be selected until at minDurability (e.g. set to 1 to never break a tool)
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.durabil: Prevents mining when going under minDurability
Prevents mining when going under minDurability
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.customT:
Add custom tool-configurations in JSON format
e.g. {"minecraft:block_id":"minecraft:tool_id"} or customTools={"minecraft:block_id":["minecraft:tool_id_1", "minecraft:tool_id_2"]}
When adding multiple tools, the first one has the highest priority
There are also pre-define lists for tool groups: autotools:pickaxe, autotools:axe, autotools:shovel, autotools.hoe, autotools:sword
Use "autotools:disabled" to disable AutoTools on a certain block
Also works for entities: "minecraft:entity_id":"minecraft:tool_id

text.autoconfig.autotools.option.experim:
[Experimental] Adds an experimental 1 Tick = 50ms delay if toggle is enabled before breaking a block after a tool switch.
Enable this only if you are experiencing Desyncs like Ghost-Blocks when instant mining.
